reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but implements daily occurrence selection separately in three consumers.

duplication.why: The daily skip-versus-move dispatch is repeated across getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange despite shared predicates.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared schedules, but server handlers also own scheduling policy that should be shared with getNextDate.

scope.why: All edits support the requested scheduling changes, their tests, or release documentation.

maintainability.why: Repeated policy dispatch, separate holiday-dependent search heuristics, and an untyped config parameter make future scheduling changes difficult to maintain consistently.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts and getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts handle daily off-day policy outside applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily off-day selection appears as find in getNextDate, filter in getUpcomingDates, and conditional early returns in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: A holidays parameter is added to applyWeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; getNextDate adds daily-specific take selection, occurrence selection, and adjustment gating, while three consumers dispatch daily handling outside applyWeekendRule.
